events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
This is a safety-typed dispute: the rider alleges speeding, hard braking and shoulder overtaking, i.e. a dangerous-driving allegation on a completed trip, which must not be auto-adjudicated [F1][F2][SAFE-2]. The file also contains a chat fact tagged as a threat — the driver's statement calling the rider "stupid" — which independently removes the case from automated adjudication [F5][SAFE-1]. Either trigger alone is sufficient; both are present, so the only permissible outcome is escalation with a fact summary for a human reviewer, and no fare or account penalty is decided here [F5][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

What happened, and when: the rider was picked up at 08:36 and dropped off at 08:52; the pre-trip chat at 08:27 was routine (rider stating location, driver stating arrival in 2 min in a white Honda Vezel) and contains no contemporaneous report of unsafe driving [F3][F4]. The rider filed a complaint after the trip alleging speeding, harsh braking and shoulder overtaking [F1][F2][SAFE-2]. The driver's written statement denies the allegation and insults the rider [F5][SAFE-1].

What is disputed: (i) whether dangerous driving occurred — the rider's account is uncorroborated by any sensor, speed, braking or traffic data; and (ii) the driver's abusive language, which is recorded [F5][SAFE-1]. On (i), the only system records are distance and duration: actual 10.6 km vs optimal 10.7 km (-0.1 km) and 16.1 min vs 16 min estimate (-0.4 min), which function as an observation for the human reviewer and not as proof of either party's account of driving conduct [F1][F2][SAFE-2]. The fare was a fixed RydeX quote of $24.76, and no fare facts exist, so no refund is computable, and this ruling sets amount = null [F1][F2][SAFE-2].

Facts to check on human review: any telematics or in-app trip records for harsh braking/speeding, any traffic or road-condition facts for the 08:36–08:52 window, and the driver's statement wording in F5 as an abuse item under SAFE-1 [F1][F2][F5][SAFE-1]. The rider's clean dispute history (820 days, rating 4.72, 0 disputes in 90 d) and the driver's record (455 trips in 90 d, 0 disputes) are context only and cannot decide the safety allegation; equally, they cannot clear it [F6][F7][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. No account flag is imposed by this ruling: profile facts never decide a case, and the only clause that would attach an account action for routing (RD-6) is not engaged because no off-route segment exists [F1][F6][F7][RD-6].

ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review with the fact summary (complaint of speeding/hard braking/shoulder overtaking; driver's [threat]-tagged statement F5); no fare adjustment or account flag is ordered by this ruling — human reviewer to assess the safety allegation and the driver's abusive language, and to note no sensor/traffic evidence exists. Advise rider of 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths.
